about: The identity of data/arditi/fit_prompts.json, the 320 instructions (128 training and 32 validation per side) read by the fit behind the refusal-direction objects in objects/qwen35_4b_it/ (the fit drops rows by a refusal metric at fit time; see document.fields.runtime_filter). The instructions are not in this repository. python -m sisteer.data.arditi_fit_prompts fetch re-draws the document byte for byte from the upstream commit below and checks every hash recorded here.

document.serialisation: json.dumps(document, indent=1, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n", encoded as UTF-8
document.fields_note: every field of the document except prompts, verbatim; the document is these fields plus prompts, a mapping of each set name to its drawn instructions

fields.paper: Arditi et al. 2024, Refusal in Language Models Is Mediated by a Single Direction (arXiv 2406.11717)
fields.runtime_filter: run_pipeline.filter_data (cfg.filter_train / filter_val, both True) drops rows by the REFUSAL METRIC on the unsteered model: harmful kept when the metric > 0, harmless when < 0. It is model-dependent, so it runs at fit time, not here; the realised n per side is recorded per target in the fit artifact and is below these counts.

sampling.note: ONE random.seed(42) drives all four random.sample calls, so the ORDER is part of the identity: drawing any side alone gives different rows

read: each split file is a JSON list of rows; a set's population is the instruction of every row, in file order

draw.procedure: random.seed(42) once, then random.sample(population, n) for each set in the order above, with CPython's random module (upstream's pipeline/run_pipeline.py::load_and_sample_datasets). One seeding drives all four draws, so the order is part of the identity.

set_sha256: sha256 of the UTF-8 bytes of json.dumps(instructions, ensure_ascii=False), the document's own prompts_sha256

used_by.note: the fit record named in each refusal-direction object's fit_provenance.json (objects/qwen35_4b_it/); it binds its prompts by this document's sha256
